releases.name: Lily or Horse
releases.summary: The easiest game in the world. Flip a coin and call it: lily or horse? Call it right 10 times in a row to win. Miss, and the coins you bet are thrown away. With a little luck, it only takes 10 flips.

releases.name: Behind the Corner
releases.summary: A first-person psychological horror game focused on atmosphere, exploration, and survival inside a dark vintage environment.

releases.name: 7 Millimeters
releases.summary: Start your journey as a carpenter in a new neighborhood. Take measurements, install furniture and fulfill customer orders. But success attracts trouble; a local gang demands a fee. Refuse, turn your shop into a fortress, and arm yourself to defend your life. will you pay or resist?

releases.name: Celiana of the Splitting Light
releases.summary: The virus hit suddenly...Nobody really understands how it happened, but it did!The Zombie Apocalypse is in full effect.Of the few who were not overtaken by the virus, only one man is brave enough to take on these evil demons.Only one man can save the city!YOU ARE STICKMAN!Run through the city shooting zombies and jumping from broken road to broken road. Just don't run into any road blocks or you may end up just like them!By the way... what do flies eat?

releases.name: SND
releases.summary: Are you ready for the ultimate racing experience for iOS?Offroad Monster Truck is a MUST-HAVE for any Race enthusiasts! Join the revolution and start Racing TODAY!Offroad Monster Truck is a heart-pounding, visually astounding 3D racer that puts the control directly in your hands.Offroad Monster Truck combines stunning, high-fidelity graphics with addictive gameplay and In Offroad Monster Truck, being daring and passing Avoid traffic, to help you through your chase and your score.And when you’re ready, it’s time to challenge the players that rule the game.Key features:- Console quality 3D graphics- Play Offline.- Real 3D environment and Trucks!- Real physics.- Fast paced, intense gameplay.

releases.name: The Wrong Village
releases.summary: A pixel-art beat 'em up set in a Portuguese village. Take one of four family heroes through eight levels of combos, specials and bosses, solo or in 2-player local co-op. They picked the wrong family.

releases.name: DODGE GAME
releases.summary: Dodge relentless enemy swarms, build score-multiplying combos, and unleash devastating powers in a fast-paced arcade survival game. Conquer evolving arenas, defeat intense bosses, and climb the leaderboards.

releases.name: KEEP IT ON HER
releases.summary: Work the night shift in a hotel where looking away can get you killed. Answer calls, handle guest requests, and keep a relentless presence caught in your flashlight. Doors buy seconds. One touch ends your shift.

releases.name: Pocket Sports
releases.summary: Grab a friend and split one handheld down the middle. Air hockey, bowling, sumo and Turf Wars for two: each player holds one side, or play online with a Steam friend. Quick matches, big hits, zero setup.

releases.name: Plight
releases.summary: A medieval roguelike where you fight and explore to become stronger. Delve into the grasslands to gain strength and tenacity to challenge and defeat the Boss.

releases.name: Little Angler
releases.summary: Little Angler is a cozy fishing game that lives on your desktop. Catch dozens of creatures, complete your album, explore new regions, earn coins, unlock upgrades, and customize your angler with characters, islands, bobbers, rods, vests, and more.

releases.name: Sad Damn
releases.summary: Sad Damn is hiding. Use your fortress to blast your way to him. Tear through his generals' defenses, get better weapons, and try not to get blown up first.

releases.name: Hivemind
releases.summary: Hivemind is a free online party game where players give clues, guess hidden targets on fun spectrums, and score points by thinking alike. Perfect for game nights, remote hangouts, icebreakers, and quick laughs with friends.

releases.name: Eggsecution Squad
releases.summary: Eggsecution Squad is a fast, chaotic egg brawler for up to 4 players — local or online. Grab 14+ wild weapons, dash, block and punch across 5 maps, and knock the other eggs off or kill them. Last egg standing wins. Dress your egg up and beat up your friends (in game).

releases.name: SHAME
releases.summary: SHAME, A Survival Horror Game, Where Player must survive through the night against vampire like creatures. Gear up with the vast amount of weapons to slay these beast, shop for ammo and resources , and try your best to survive through the night.

releases.name: A Cruise for Murder
releases.summary: A 3D modern remake of the classic Cruise for a Corpse, along with original music, different plot and 15 puzzles.

releases.name: Biden Blast
releases.summary: Brawls on the island, cigarette-butt tossing, and a stealthy hunt for lightbulbs in the stairwell—welcome to Biden Blast. Play solo or compete against friends in absurd challenges where accuracy and audacity are everything.

releases.name: CHAINSPIRE
releases.summary:
CHAINSPIRE is a soul-like platformer for 1-4 players connected by a real physical chain. Your friend will become your enemy the very moment they stop listening to you.

The chain here is the real thing: it catches on geometry, goes taut, and drags back whoever wasn't paying attention. The difficulty climbs steadily as you go, and the bigger the party, the harder it gets for everyone in it.

If you have no one to play with, or you'd rather make the climb alone, an AI companion takes the other end of the chain. It follows your route, fights alongside you and turns up where a second pair of hands is needed. Solo is a full mode, not a concession: the chain is still there, and so are all of its rules.

releases.name: Last House Standing
releases.summary: One house, a lab inside, and thousands of zombies outside. Hold out for 25 waves while Dr. Ferrán finishes the cure. Every run earns coins for the upgrade tree: barbed wire, bear traps, mines, a mortar on the roof and, if you make it that far, an airstrike.

releases.name: Moon Sweepers
releases.summary: Stop being lazy, you’ve got whole Moon to clean. Better get started.

releases.name: Catch The Ducks
releases.summary: Catch The Ducks is a colorful online party game where ducks and farmers clash across chaotic arenas. Chase, escape, paint and customize your character, then compete in Classic, Battle, Free Fall, Hot Potato and Infection modes.
